techniques.name: Active Scanning
techniques.description: Direct probing of target infrastructure to gather information for reconnaissance.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Abuse of a weakness in an internet-accessible application or service to gain initial access.

techniques.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
techniques.description: Use of a server-side web component to retain access to a web server, potentially allowing remote interaction.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Use of a command or script interpreter to execute instructions on a system.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
techniques.description: Transfer of data over a protocol other than the existing command-and-control channel.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
techniques.description: Use of sudo, its cached credentials or a permissive sudoers configuration to run commands with higher privileges.
